    "## The `Raster` object\n",
    "\n",
    "The `Raster` object is a primitive class that lives under `plans.datasets` module. The `Raster` object stores all core methods for working with single-banded, gridded spatial data (maps)."
   ]

    "## Working with data\n",
    "\n",
    "Raster data files are expected to be in the standard `tif` (GeoTiff) format.\n",
    "\n",
    "For the `Raster` core object, data type is parsed as `float32`, that is, the data is treated as real numbers by default (instead of integers, for example).\n"
   ]

    "    geometry=[box(xmin + 500, ymin + 500, xmax - 500, ymax - 500)]\n",

    "rs.view()\n",

    "## Types of Rasters"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f3d43c863d073c27",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `Raster` class is extented into several families or types."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b477c89baa468227",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### `SciRaster` family\n",
    "\n",
    "This is a large family of rasters that are numerical values. Behaviour is nearly the same from `Raster` base class, but `NODATA_value` and `dtype` is enforced to the incoming data.\n",
    "\n",
    "Members of this family are all conventional quantitative spatial variables, like terrain elevation or soil water content."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 21,
   "id": "7de7c2ccaeb8df2e",
   "metadata": {

     "start_time": "2026-11-03T12:15:20.995700Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from plans.datasets import SciRaster"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
